author: Fisher, Harold H.
title: The Famine in Soviet Russia, 1919-1923: The Operations of the American Relief Administration
notes: Out of copyright and readable in full. Written by the chief of the American Relief Administration's own historical department from the ARA's records, which is both why it is detailed and why it is partial: it is the institutional history of one relief operation, and the famine reaches it through the eyes of the people feeding it. Cited here for the relief operation and for its opening account of what the blockade and the fighting had done, not for a death toll - the toll is in the literature this project could not open.
